reference_figures.label: Cube 2

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='20,20 80,20 80,80 20,80' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

options.label: D
options.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100'><polygon points='50,5 90,25 90,75 50,95 10,75 10,25' fill='none' stroke='black' stroke-width='4'/></svg>

explanation: Options A (Triangle/3), B (Pentagon/5), and D (Hexagon/6 sides). Option C is the only shape with parallel sides (Square).
